passage:
Every new student at Hill School receives a guide written by older students. It does not only list rules. It gives advice.
One page says, "The third-floor water machine is coldest." Another says, "Do not worry if you get lost in Building B. Everyone does." There is also a list of teachers who open classrooms during lunch for quiet study.
The guide began after several new students said they felt nervous but did not know whom to ask.
Older students update it every year. They remove old information and add new tips.
The guide shows that welcoming someone is not only saying hello. It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “Every new student at Hill School receives a guide written by older students.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The Door That Stayed Open」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The New Student Guide: Every new student at Hill School receives a guide written by older students.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The School Map」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The New Rule」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

questions.stem: What happens next in this passage after “There is also a list of teachers who open classrooms during lunch for quiet study.”?
options: After lunch, the internet became weak, and several students could not use their maps online.
A teacher started it after noticing that some students felt tired during lunch.
After class, several students asked Jenny about the song.
The guide began after several new students said they felt nervous but did not know whom to ask.

本文沒有陳述「A teacher started it after noticing that some students felt tired during lunch.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After class, several students asked Jenny about the song.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「There is also a list of teachers who open classrooms during lunch for quiet study. The guide began after several new students…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.
It is giving in a way that protects the person receiving it.
